articles.title: Adequate fuel stock available in India amidst crisis: Athawale
articles.summary: Union Minister Ramdas Athawale, visiting Jammu, highlighted the Central government's wide-ranging developmental initiatives. He underscored progress in social justice, empowerment, and economic growth through various welfare schemes. The minister emphasized efforts to integrate Jammu with the national mainstream, ensuring equitable development and prosperity for all sections of society, reflecting the government's commitment to regional upliftment.

articles.title: nomi-context added to PyPI
articles.summary: Nomi is a local context engine infrastructure that optimizes AI coding agents. It sits between developer codebases and these agents, significantly reducing token usage and latency. By preventing repeated full file loads, Nomi enhances efficiency, allowing AI coding tools to operate faster and more cost-effectively. This innovation streamlines development workflows, improving overall productivity for teams utilizing AI assistance.

articles.title: Ikea’s DIY plans for India
articles.summary: The article describes a serene afternoon at Chennai's venerable Madras Club, situated on the tranquil Adyar river banks. Its sprawling, leafy environs are portrayed as quiet and peaceful, with mild sunlight filtering through. This evocative opening sets a calm, balmy scene in a historic Indian location.
